name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Movement of the Mind) — 1 Basic — Manipulate

system.description:
The thaumaturge's control of unseen force tightens to fine work, toying with a distant object as deftly as with a single hand.

Manipulating an object takes your full concentration and counts as your turn. You may lift, push a button, fire a gun and the like, but the difficulty of fine remote control forces you to risk an extra Trait in any challenge involving the object. It moves only at walking speed and can be nothing larger than you could lift with one hand. The object stays under your control as long as you can see it and keep concentrating; take any other action and the spell ends. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
